title: VISUALS: beat radar, a pet, Snake, Pong and screen effects
author: Cere, made with Claude
description: Eye candy. Master pages (FUNC + LFO, then LEFT/RIGHT): RDR a beat radar (a sweep round the active track's loop, blips for each hit at its track's place, track 1 inside, 8 outside), PET a little creature that dances to the music and sleeps in silence (turn a knob to pet it), SNK Snake in time with the pattern, PNG Pong against the Digitakt (knob A or UP/DOWN), with knob H playing a track's sound on each catch, and SCR the screen effects, saved: CRT (a rolling refresh line; FUL adds the old-TV power off and on at stop and play, and glitches) and INV (the whole screen flashes on loud hits, beat 1 or track 1). Needs seq-events.
